Official Axom AI Research

Practical AI built in Assam, published with real numbers

What we built, how we measured it, what worked, what failed and what we still cannot do. Every report links to its code, its data and its limits.

SBy Samarjit Kashyap, Axom AIPublished 26 Oct 2026Updated 26 Oct 2026

What is Axom AI Research?

Axom AI Research is the home of technical reports from Axom AI, Assam's first indigenous generative AI platform. Each report explains a system we built, the data and tools behind it, the results we measured on data the model had never seen, and the places where it still fails.

Featured report

Computer vision · Road safety

Helmet Detection: every rider checked, from a phone video or a CCTV camera

An end-to-end system: YOLOv8 detection, per-rider tracking, an Android app, an admin dashboard and live CCTV alerts. Recall on held-out CCTV frames rose from 0.62 to 0.79 after fine-tuning; the live worker caught about 90% of bare-headed riders at two analysed frames per second.

Read the report →

How we publish

Numbers you can check

Results come from clips the model never trained on, and we say how they were measured.

Limits next to results

Night, distance, speed and bias are written beside the good news, not hidden at the end.

Credit where it is due

Every dataset, model and tool is named with its licence.

Open code

Our code is on GitHub so others can repeat and improve the work.

Updated, never erased

Corrections and new results go in with a date. Wrong early findings stay visible, marked as wrong.
